title: Parents and Children
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Parents and children describes the family relationship in which parents are called to love, teach, discipline, and care for children, and children are called to honor and obey parents in the Lord. These responsibilities must be governed by God’s Word.
summary: Parents and children describes the family relationship in which parents are called to love, teach, discipline, and care for children, and children are called to honor and obey parents in the Lord. These responsibilities must be governed by God’s Word.
christFocus: Jesus Christ welcomes children and reveals the Father’s tender care. Under His lordship, homes are called to reflect instruction, patience, honor, protection, humility, and love.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God cares about the relationship between parents and children. Children are called to obey and honor parents in the Lord, and parents are called to raise children with instruction rather than provocation.

Parental authority is real, but it is not absolute or selfish. Parents must not use authority to crush, embitter, neglect, or abuse children. They answer to God for how they shepherd the young.

Children are to learn honor, obedience, wisdom, and reverence for God. This does not mean obeying commands that require sin, but it does mean receiving family life as a place of discipleship.

Godly family life points beyond behavior management. Parents and children alike need grace, repentance, forgiveness, patience, and the Word of God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Family relationships can be places of deep joy or deep pain. This doctrine calls parents and children to live before Christ, not merely according to personality, culture, or family habit.

It also protects children by reminding parents that biblical authority must be exercised with care, gentleness, instruction, and love.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: If you are a parent, shepherd your children with patience, truth, prayer, and humble repentance when you fail. If you are a child, honor your parents in the Lord. Let Christ shape family relationships with grace, wisdom, correction, and love.
